# Heartbeat check (generated by scripts/gate.py)

8 s windows. Thresholds per fold from the 2 tune people's real windows (95% of them pass); tested on the fold's 4 unseen people. Pass rates are per person, then averaged over the 16 development people. Real = the person's 'late' SCG; negatives use 2 min per person.

## Fraction of windows that pass

| input             |   pass_periodicity |   pass_agreement |   pass_both |
|:------------------|-------------------:|-----------------:|------------:|
| real              |              0.918 |            0.729 |       0.673 |
| sign_flipped_real |              0.896 |            0.838 |       0.758 |
| white_noise       |              0     |            0     |       0     |
| pink_noise        |              0     |            0     |       0     |
| brown_noise       |              0     |            0     |       0     |
| shuffled_50ms     |              0.004 |            0.412 |       0     |
| shuffled_200ms    |              0.004 |            0.579 |       0.004 |

real should be near 0.95; sign_flipped_real is a real heartbeat with the sensor's sign reversed (a polarity check); every other row should be near 0.

## Real windows: is the U-Net output worse where the gate rejects?

unet_r = correlation of the 3-seed mean output with the real ECG in that window.

| kept   |   count |   median |   mean |
|:-------|--------:|---------:|-------:|
| False  |     769 |    0.575 |  0.546 |
| True   |    1587 |    0.812 |  0.696 |
